title: Cost Pulse: Token Dissector Compact Panel & Export Patterns
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Operators and product teams need a compact, embeddable console panel that surfaces token-level cost breakdowns and attribution for routes and models without overwhelming dashboards. Current cost views either show coarse rollups or full-page explorers that are heavy for quick troubleshooting.

Goal: Design a compact 'Cost Pulse' panel (300–480px wide) used in route, model, and rollout pages that: (a) shows per-token spend sparklines and top contributors, (b) exposes attribution method toggles and export controls, and (c) supports role-aware line items for CSV/NDJSON export.

Scope: Visual components, UX patterns for attribution selection, export spec (CSV + NDJSON + JSONL sampling), accessibility and responsive behavior, and a prototype for PM/Eng review. Out-of-scope: backend batching algorithms and billing engine changes (handled by ENG dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: Compact panel design that fits in 320px and 420px widths with responsive collapse behavior
Visuals for per-token sparklines, top-5 contributor list, and 3 attribution modes (first-touch, proportional, hybrid) defined
Export flows documented: CSV (defaults), NDJSON (detailed line items), and JSONL (sampled full traces) with column mapping and role-aware filters
Prototype links (Figma) and PRD (Drive) shared with PM and ENG; PM sign-off on column names and default attribution
Design tokens and component spec ready for handoff (colors, spacing, micro-interactions, aria labels)
decisions: Default attribution = proportional in the compact panel (better for blended workloads); first-touch remains available as a toggle
Show top-5 contributors by default; provide a 'show more' link that opens full explorer
Export defaults to CSV with role-aware line items; advanced exports (NDJSON, JSONL) behind an 'Advanced export' dropdown
Sparklines use 1m bucket resolution with hover drill to 15s when available (perf/telemetry dependent)
Panel collapses to a single-row badge when space-constrained, preserving key metric and 'open' affordance
tradeoffs: Compactness vs. detail: sacrifice immediate full-trace visibility to keep panel lightweight; link to full explorer for deep dives
Attribution complexity vs. user clarity: offer three modes but hide technical details behind an 'explain attribution' microcopy to avoid confusion
Export richness vs. backend load: JSONL full-trace export requires sampling to avoid high-cost exports; sampling policy documented in PRD
review_feedback: PM - Lina Zhou: 'Love the compact approach. Please align CSV column names with billing ledger (see PM-402) and surface model variant in exports.'
ENG - Mateo Ruiz: 'Backend needs a new endpoint for sampled JSONL; ENG-5633 to own. Suggest limiting advanced exports to org-admins due to cost.'
Security - Priya Nair: 'Ensure export respects RBAC and PII redaction; add note to design that KMS audit metadata must be preserved in NDJSON exports.'
Design - Janice K: 'Micro-interaction for the attribution toggle should persist per-user; add small toast explaining attribution change effects on historical numbers.'

2025-02-16: Low-fi comps shared in Figma; PM requested explicit export column mapping and sample export files. Added export spec to Drive PRD.
2025-02-17: Usability mini-session with two SREs and a Billing SME; discovered need for role-aware export and sampling policy for large tenants.
2025-02-18: High-fi prototype completed (320/420 widths), microcopy for attribution modes drafted. Submitted design review request to PM & ENG.
2025-02-19: Addressed ENG feedback on sparklines resolution and added 'Advanced export' permission gating. Updated prototype and annotated component spec.
2025-02-20: In Review: design presented to Console design guild. Awaiting final PM sign-off and ENG estimate for export endpoints.
